notes.title: The game "Rusty Robot" has evolved into the new game "Coin-Op VICE"
notes.notes:
The game "Rusty Robot Wants to Cry" has evolved into the new game "Coin-Op VICE". All levels from "Rusty Robot Wants to Cry" are preserved. Now they can be played on the arcade machines of the large gaming center. A detective from the 80s arrives at a huge arcade center damaged by a cosmic beam. Crowds of visitors have turned into monsters, and arcade machines are running unusual versions of legendary games.

The game has become more complex. The storyline has changed as well. Therefore, I have decided to change the project's name. I would appreciate it if you could visit the Coin-Op VICE game page and consider adding it to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2722640/CoinOp_Vice/

The project under the name "Rusty Robot Wants to Cry" is closing. Thank you very much to everyone.
